record.reason: OmniSeek uses selective temporal audio/video evidence retrieval with native tools rather than processing an entire sequence at once. The primary text evaluates long-video/audio-visual reasoning and documents a 32K-token context bottleneck for long raw audio (roughly 90K tokens for two hours). It is an agent/tool integration recipe with no demonstrated direct reduction in LLM inference cost; keep as a weak long-context adjacent item.
record.title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
